tagline: Helping everyone hear and see the beauty in the world
hero_kpi_rationale: E-commerce is a key strategic lever in the group's omnichannel transformation, with growth of +17% in 2023 while the German market declined by 12%, marking strong differentiation in digital customer experience.

kpis.name: Online Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales generated through Fielmann group's digital channels.
kpis.description: Online sales exceeded 100 million euros in 2023, representing 5% of group total sales, driven by improvements to the omnichannel platform.
kpis.signal: Strong growth despite declining e-commerce market.

kpis.name: International Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of sales generated outside the home market (Germany).
kpis.description: International sales represented 35% of total revenue in Q4 2023, versus 21% in 2019, driven by growth in Austria, Italy, Poland, Spain and US acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Accelerated internationalization with momentum in Europe and the United States.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of eyeglasses, contact lenses, hearing aids and services.
kpis.description: Revenue reached 2.27 billion euros in 2023, up 11.6% versus 2022, driven by organic performance and international expansion.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth despite inflation and declining consumer spending.

kpis.name: EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: EBITDA divided by revenue, measuring operating profitability.
kpis.description: EBITDA margin improved from 19.3% in 2022 to 20.8% in 2023, marking a recovery after several years of decline.
kpis.signal: Margin expansion driven by improved product mix and cost reduction.

kpis.name: Eyeglass Unit Sales
kpis.explanation: Total number of eyeglass pairs sold by the group.
kpis.description: The group sold 8.891 million pairs of eyeglasses in 2023, up 3.6% versus 2022.
kpis.signal: Stable volume growth despite challenging economic environment.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: CAPEX for network development and digitalization.
kpis.description: CAPEX reached 268.4 million euros in 2023, versus 152.5 million in 2022, primarily directed toward network expansion and US acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Significant CAPEX increase to support international growth and digital transformation.

kpis.name: Store Count
kpis.explanation: Total number of physical retail points operated by the group globally.
kpis.description: The group operated 1,086 stores as of end 2023, versus 968 in 2022, with accelerating store openings in Europe and the United States.
kpis.signal: Rapid network expansion, +118 stores in one year.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of group employees at period-end.
kpis.description: The group employed 23,412 people at end 2023, versus 22,631 in 2022, supporting operational and international growth.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth in line with group expansion.

kpis.name: United States Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales generated by US operations following SVS Vision and Befitting acquisitions.
kpis.description: The acquisitions of SVS Vision (September 2023) and Befitting (June 2023) enabled the group to generate 32 million euros in US sales from September 2023 onward.
kpis.signal: Successful US market entry with 32 million euros in sales within months.

kpis.name: Digital Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of sales generated through digital channels in total revenue.
kpis.description: Digital sales represented 5% of total revenue in 2023, growing strongly while the German e-commerce market declined by 12%.
kpis.signal: Rising digital penetration with market leadership amid declining e-commerce market.

risks.title: Supply chain and centralized production dependency
risks.score_rationale: Risk implicitly referenced through business model description: production concentrated in Rathenow, Germany with 17,000 lenses/day and 62,000 orders processed. Neutral language but critical infrastructure exposure. Trend stable but geographic vulnerability heightened by US expansion (SVS Vision). High weight for omnichannel operator.

risks.title: Intense competition from e-commerce and pure-play retailers
risks.score_rationale: Market position section reveals Fielmann generates €2.5M/store in Germany versus €0.3M for traditional optometrists, but regulatory section implicitly mentions e-commerce competition. Market data (80,000 stores, €40B in Europe) shows fragmentation. Measured language but major structural risk for retail model. Trend up with rising digital adoption.

risks.title: Strict medical device regulation and multi-country compliance
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory environment explicitly addressed: 'manufacture and sale of these products is strictly regulated and subject to many conditions'. Detailed coverage of reimbursement regimes (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, USA) indicates regulatory complexity. Direct language on constraints. Trend stable but growing weight with geographic expansion (7 countries in Europe + USA).

risks.title: Integration and performance of recent acquisitions (SVS Vision, Eyevious)
risks.score_rationale: Section details 5 major acquisitions over 3 years (Optika Clarus 2019, Óptica & Audiología 2020, Medical Óptica 2022, SVS Vision Sept 2023, Eyevious June 2023). SVS Vision: 82 stores, 9 US states, production plus vision insurance. Factual language but high integration risk. Trend up (acceleration in 2023). Critical weight: 1,086 stores end 2023 versus 968 in 2022 (+12%).

risks.title: Dependence on health insurance and reimbursement regimes
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory section emphasizes reimbursements play 'minor role' in optical (except Switzerland/Austria) but major role in hearing aids (Germany/Switzerland/Austria). Nuanced language but real dependence on public policy. Trend stable but vulnerability to health reforms. Moderate weight: hearing aids = 385 stores (35% of network).

risks.title: Cybersecurity and customer data protection (28 million customers)
risks.score_rationale: Section mentions 'omnichannel platform' and 'innovative technologies' (optical measurement, primary eyecare) but no explicit disclosure of cyber risks. Absence of IT security/data detail is itself a signal. Neutral language. Trend up (accelerating digitalization). Moderate weight: 28M customers + sensitive health data (vision, insurance).

risks.title: Brand portfolio concentration and Fielmann brand dependence
risks.score_rationale: Business description: Fielmann operates under 5 brands (Fielmann, Optika Clarus, Óptica & Audiología, Medical Óptica, SVS Vision) but Fielmann dominates (>50% market share in Germany). Neutral language but risk of brand cannibalization/confusion. Trend stable. Moderate weight: acquired brands = 15% of network (~160 stores).

risks.title: Dependence on demographic growth and myopia trends
risks.score_rationale: Market position section: 'ageing population and increasing myopia in younger generations are the key drivers'. Positive language but reveals dependence on exogenous factors. Trend stable (long-term structural factors). Moderate weight: organic growth depends on these trends.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2023 annual report. The group does not position AI as a strategic lever in its transformation or customer offering.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation in the text.
Innovations cited relate to omnichannel platform and digitalized Eye Health Services, but without AI technical detail.
No indicator of AI adoption or investment in intelligent tools mentioned in the report.
